I've been editing video since 2016, and somewhere along the way the work stopped stopping at the timeline. I still cut every project I take on through Fiverr — pacing, colour correction, sound, delivery — but I also show up on set as an assistant director, and behind the camera as a cinematographer for clients who need someone to shoot it right the first time. As AD I worked with Chilekotha Films on two features, Kathbirali and Roktojoba.

That range shows up in the work: factory walkthroughs, restaurant videography, real estate listings, car features, and coverage for Accelerator Bangladesh, a national government initiative. Different briefs, different crews, different deadlines — the constant is that I understand both ends of the process, from the call sheet to the final export.

If your project needs someone who can plan the shoot, run the camera, and cut the footage — not hand it off between three different people — that's the job I do.
